pages.en:
Please return this file to:
CENTRAL REGISTRY
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Commandant.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 21
Date
January 29th 1916

Sir,
The Arsenal Authorities received a code telegram from
the Central Government instructing them to hurry up with
the manufacture of arms and ammunition, which are to be
conveyed to Peking by the gunboat Tsu Ching 楚生 .
A second telegram was received yesterday by the same official
from the same source ordering them to take special precautions
during the new year holidays. Troops are to be exempt from
drill, but are not to be permitted to leave barracks.
It is reported that the rebels intend to ask the City
Chamber of Commerce and the Settlement Chamber of Commerce
to contribute $50,000.00 and $100,000.00 respectively
towards their funds.
It is reported that there are still 2,000 destitute persons
wandering from one place to another in Pootung.
Mr.Zee Koh Liang Chief of Shanghai Woosung Police
enrolled 100 recruits at the temple of the God of Fire in the
City yesterday. As soon as the new men are trained, they will
be attached to the Salt Smuggling Prevention Force.

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

pages.zh:
请将此卷宗归还至：
中央登记处
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探部）

总监。
上海工部局。
刑事侦缉处。
I. O. REG
第 21 号
日期
1916年1月29日

先生：
兵工厂当局收到中央政府发来的密电，指示其加快武器弹药的制造，这些军火将由“楚生”号炮舰运往北京。
昨日，该官员又收到来自同一来源的第二封电报，命令其在新年假期期间采取特别预防措施。士兵可免除操练，但不得离开营房。
据报，反叛者意图要求上海总商会和公共租界总商会分别向其资金库捐助50,000.00美元和100,000.00美元。
据报，浦东仍有2,000名贫民四处流浪。
上海吴淞警察局局长谢阁良（Zee Koh Liang，音译）先生昨日在城内的火神庙招募了100名新兵。一旦新人完成训练，他们将被编入缉私盐队。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
首席探长。

警务处警司。

4... ... ... 1月29日
